prompts.epic_class_shop_v2:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Deliver ONE portrait raster mobile game UI concept, exactly 390x844 aspect, full bleed, no device frame. Soft Miniature cream rounded bevelled panels, glossy blue header, navy rounded bold typography, orange glossy purchase button. Vietnamese diacritics must be readable and correct.
CRITICAL IDENTITY: use the actual supplied runtime car render as the hero, preserve its exact geometry, wheel size, body proportions, white twin stripes, paint colors, lighting, angle and blue/cream checkerboard circular turntable. Do NOT redesign the car. Class names are destination facilities only, NEVER vehicle types. No rally car, truck, motorcycle, monster truck, new body style or class-specific vehicle. The older concept is UI style only, NEVER a source for the vehicle. Match runtime car, not any generic description of a hatch/coupe/hypercar.
New destination selector: label "Nhận vào:"; six small rounded cream chips with tan outline, navy readable type, selected chip green with a checkmark and white type. Arrange two compact rows of three to make ALL SIX labels fully readable: first row "Racing", "Rally", "Stock Car"; second row "Superbike", "Speedster", "Monster Truck". Put these above the purchase button. No vehicle icons in chips. Exactly one selected. Price everywhere "$9,99", decimal COMMA. Footer "Mua một lần • Khôi phục được". Do not invent rewards, currencies, countdowns or stats. Epic rule is top of tier × 1.09; don't invent numeric stat values.
Generate the Shop section "XE EPIC", not a popup. Image 1 runtime Pico is PRIMARY car identity. Image 2 runtime Nova is next card identity. Remaining five-body runtime renders and sheet are identity checks; old epic_shop_v1 is card STYLE only, approved shop is finishing STYLE only.
390x844 entire portrait Shop view, crop focus on this section. Blue "XE EPIC" gift/checker banner at top, cream rounded carousel outer panel, ONE FULL LARGE PICO EPIC product card about 310px wide, plus a thin slice of next NOVA EPIC card clipped at RIGHT edge (not two full cards). One horizontal carousel only, dots under cards. PICO must be identical to runtime Pico: cyan blue short rounded body, darker blue fenders, bubble blue canopy, round yellow headlights, white twin stripes, straight blue wing, beige hubs, black tires. Nova sliver uses actual GREEN/TEAL Nova and same round turntable; no other vehicle.
Within full Pico card: purple EPIC ribbon and purple sparkles; real car on blue/cream checkerboard turntable, bold navy "PICO EPIC", cyan "Độc quyền" pill, EXACTLY FOUR short icon-led unnumbered segmented stat bars matching existing Shop: speedometer BLUE, rocket YELLOW, tire GREEN, balance scales PURPLE, in that order. Under four bars place new "Nhận vào:" selector in two rows of 3 chips with Racing selected green and all other cream, all six names fully visible. Orange glossy "$9,99" button, footer "Mua một lần • Khôi phục được". Partial next card may show Nova car but its details are naturally clipped. Keep all content comfortable and readable at 390 logical pixels. Soft cream/blue surrounding Shop background, no unrelated product section, no invented offers or prices.
Image 3 identity sheet, image 4 old Shop card style ONLY (ignore its invented car designs), image 5 matching new selector style. Price "$9,99" must have COMMA with visible descending tail as in image 5. Match cream chip design and selected green Racing of image 5.
